contribution.position: My position is unchanged: reliability evidence is still missing in one area. The tests (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and the peak-load p99 result are good, but neither covers retry-storm behavior in the rebuild job, and retry storms caused both sev2 incidents last quarter. The ops turn cites artifact:rollback-rehearsal-q3 as a clean rollback rehearsal. That artifact is not in the available evidence, and the runbook says no rollback rehearsal has been run for the rebuild job. Unless that artifact can be produced and shown to cover this job, the recovery path is untested. Two items would settle this: a retry-storm or failure-injection result for the rebuild job, and one rehearsed rollback with a timing measurement. I am not weighing cost or schedule here.
